newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania Feb m/m CPI 0.6 pct vs 2.8 pct January.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania Feb m/m CPI 0.6 pct vs 2.8 pct January.

text.p: Lithuanian consumer prices rose by a monthly 0.6 percent in February 1997, the statistics department said.
In a statement released on Saturday, which was a working day in Lithuania, the department said that a year-on-year figure was not available as it has changed its method of calculating CPI.
The statistics department said its 1997 figures were now based on an index=100 at end 1995 rather than at end 1993.
It said that year-on-year figures and the actual index will not be available until all the previous figures have been revised in line with the new method. -- Vilnius newsroom,
